Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the SIG questionnaire. Our security team has a few follow-ups before we can close the control set:

Could you please provide: 
- Short (30–90s) MP4 walkthrough clips showing console access to: the RBAC user list, an example session where a model inference is started, and the Audit Logs search UI filtering for a single request ID.
- A screenshot of the IAM policy page showing the service account bindings (redact user emails if needed).
- A runbook excerpt (PDF or text) that describes the incident response steps for unauthorized model modification.
- Links to any diagrams that map network segmentation between control plane and customer workload.

We prefer Drive links with viewer-only access (no raw attachments) and filenames that include a short descriptor and date. Can you also include a short artifact index CSV so our evidence tracker can ingest quickly?

Target to close by EOD Friday if possible. Let me know if any items need redaction or legal review.

Thanks,
Elena
